title: A user importing horses on temporary admission can leave the exit date blank and continue with no message; DR1 asks for it on the spot with 'Enter an exit date', a message the frontend does not have.

finding.frontend: Exit date is a date picker on a page of its own, reached only when the reason is Temporary admission horses. An empty box passes: the only check the page makes is that a value, if given, parses as a real date, and the only message the page owns is 'Enter a real exit date' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/exit-date/controller.js:21, src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/exit-date/copy/copy.en.js:8). There is no message for the date being missing anywhere in the service. The rule itself is not missing: the obligation model makes the exit date mandatory whenever the reason is temporaryAdmissionHorses (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js), so the Exit details hub row stays incomplete and Check your answers cannot be opened without it. The user is let past the page and stopped later, with no words to explain either.
finding.prototype: DR1 requires the exit date once Temporary admission horses is chosen and distinguishes the two failures: an empty box gives 'Enter an exit date' and an unparseable one gives 'Enter a real date', each in the error summary and against the field (app/routes.js:1424-1432). The same submit also requires the port of exit, so a user leaving both blank sees two entries in the summary. DR1 carries the rule at the later points too — the hub reads the reason task as complete only when both are present (app/routes.js:1343-1367), and Continue on the review page is refused without them (app/routes.js:10068-10075).
finding.difference: Add the page-level check and the message that goes with it: reject a submit with the exit date empty when the reason is Temporary admission horses, with 'Enter an exit date' in the summary and against the field. The obligation is already mandatory under that reason, so nothing in the model moves — this is a validator and a copy string. Align the invalid-date message too: DR1 says 'Enter a real date' where the frontend says 'Enter a real exit date'; keep whichever the service settles on, but do not ship two different phrasings of the same failure across the journey.
finding.falsifiedBy: Submitting DR1's reason page with Temporary admission horses chosen, the exit date empty and a port of exit selected, and reaching the next screen.
finding.correction: Overstated in one respect, exactly right in another; slot rewritten. CONFIRMED AS AN ABSOLUTE: the string 'Enter an exit date' appears nowhere in trade-imports-animals-frontend or trade-imports-animals-tests — grepped both trees, no hits — and the exit-date page's only message is 'Enter a real exit date' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/exit-date/copy/copy.en.js). CLAIMED AND OVERSTATED: the user 'can leave the exit date blank and continue'. TRUE of the page, not of the journey. exitDate is mandatory in the obligation model whenever reasonForImport is temporaryAdmissionHorses (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js), which feeds rowStatus and readyForCheckYourAnswers (src/server/app/flow/section-status.js:11-15), and the review section is gated on that (flow.js:81-85), so the notification cannot be submitted without it. The difference is where the rule bites, not whether it exists. ALSO VERIFIED: DR1's two-message split at app/routes.js:1424-1432 is exactly as described, and the same submit does require the port of exit (:1434-1440). HOW CHECKED: read the exit-date page validator and copy file, the import-reason obligation section, the status roll-up and the review gate; grepped both frontend and tests repos for the absent string; read validateImportReasonProceed and hasImportReasonComplete on DR1. NOTE FOR THE PICKER, not raised as a finding here: the frontend's exit-date hint carries an extra sentence DR1 does not ('The date the animals are expected to leave Great Britain.'), covered by origin-and-reason--reveal-questions-carry-hints-dr1-does-not.

relatedTo.why: the reveal change decides where this error is shown
